en.Situation: In my first DevOps role, our service image was 1.4 GB and every deploy took nine minutes on the office connection.
en.Task: I was asked to make deploys faster, and I had to prove nothing broke.
en.Action: I moved to a multi-stage build, dropped two build tools from the runtime image, and ran the same smoke test before and after.
en.Result: The image came down to 210 MB, deploys took three minutes, and the smoke test result was identical.
en.vague: The container image was big and deploys were slow.
en.exaggerated: I rebuilt the whole pipeline and halved all our costs.
en.no_data: After the change deploys were quicker.

zh.Situation: 第一份 DevOps 工作，服務 image 有 1.4 GB，每次部署喺公司網絡要九分鐘。
zh.Task: 我要令部署快啲，並要證明冇整壞任何嘢。
zh.Action: 我改用 multi-stage build，從 runtime image 移走兩個 build 工具，改前改後都跑同一個 smoke test。
zh.Result: image 細到 210 MB，部署三分鐘，smoke test 結果完全一樣。
zh.vague: 個 container image 好大，部署好慢。
zh.exaggerated: 我重做咗整條 pipeline，令所有成本減半。

en.Situation: At a bank, a bad config change reached production twice because the pipeline had no stage between build and deploy.
en.Task: I owned the pipeline, and I wanted a cheap check that would have caught both changes.
en.Action: I added a stage that starts the container with the new config and fails if the health endpoint does not answer in ten seconds.
en.Result: Both earlier faults would have failed that stage, and two later bad configs did fail it before production.
en.vague: Bad config reached production a couple of times.
en.exaggerated: I made the bank's pipeline fully safe against any change.
en.no_data: After the stage was added, bad configs were stopped earlier.

zh.Situation: 喺銀行，錯嘅 config 兩次直接到咗 production，因為 pipeline 喺 build 同 deploy 之間乜都冇。
zh.Task: 我負責條 pipeline，要一個便宜檢查，可以捉到嗰兩次改動。
zh.Action: 我加一個 stage：用新 config 起 container，十秒內 health endpoint 冇回應就 fail。
zh.Result: 之前兩次錯誤都會 fail 呢個 stage，之後兩次壞 config 亦真喺 production 前被擋。
zh.vague: 錯 config 有幾次到咗 production。
zh.exaggerated: 我令銀行 pipeline 對任何改動都完全安全。
zh.no_data: 加咗 stage 之後，壞 config 早咗被擋。

en.Situation: One Monday, an expired certificate took down an internal API for about forty minutes before anyone noticed.
en.Task: I was on call, and I had to restore service and then make sure the next expiry was not silent.
en.Action: I replaced the certificate, added an alert thirty days before expiry, and wrote a one-page list of every certificate we own.
en.Result: The next expiry passed with two reminders, and the certificate list showed two more we had forgotten.
en.vague: A certificate expired and the service was down for a while.
en.exaggerated: I prevented all future outages in the department.
en.no_data: After the change nobody was caught by an expiry again.

zh.Situation: 有個星期一，一條證書過期令內部 API 斷咗大約四十分鐘才有人發現。
zh.Task: 我 on call，要恢復服務，然後確保下次過期唔會再無聲無息。
zh.Action: 我換咗證書，加咗到期前三十日嘅 alert，再寫一頁清單列出所有我們擁有嘅證書。
zh.Result: 下次到期前有兩次提醒，清單仲顯示多兩條我們忘記咗嘅證書。
zh.vague: 有證書過期，服務斷咗一陣。
zh.exaggerated: 我阻止咗部門未來所有故障。
zh.no_data: 改完之後冇再被過期證書殺個措手不及。

en.Situation: Four years in, our cloud bill rose forty per cent over three months and nobody could say which service caused it.
en.Task: I had to find the cause and propose a fix the team would accept, without switching anything off unilaterally.
en.Action: I grouped cost by service and tag, found one non-production database running at production size, and priced three options.
en.Result: Resizing that database removed most of the increase, and the team agreed a monthly cost review.
en.vague: The cloud bill went up and we were not sure why.
en.exaggerated: I cut the company's cloud spend in half by myself.
en.no_data: After the change the bill was closer to normal.

zh.Situation: 做咗四年，雲端帳單三個月內升咗四成，而冇人講得出係邊個服務。
zh.Task: 我要找出原因，並提出團隊接受嘅方案，但唔可以自己單方面關掉任何東西。
zh.Action: 我按服務同 tag 分組成本，發現一個非正式環境資料庫用住正式環境嘅規格，再為三個方案報價。
zh.Result: 調整該資料庫規格去掉大部分升幅，團隊亦同意每月做成本檢視。
zh.vague: 雲端帳單升咗，我哋都唔清楚原因。
zh.exaggerated: 我一個人令公司雲端開支減半。
zh.no_data: 改完之後帳單接近正常。

en.Situation: In my internship, the deployment steps lived in a chat thread and each person ran them slightly differently.
en.Task: I was asked to write them down, and I had to check each step with the person who usually ran it.
en.Action: I ran the deployment twice while taking notes, then rewrote the steps with the exact command and the expected output.
en.Result: Two people followed the new page without asking for help, and one step that was optional got removed.
en.vague: Deployment steps were only in chat messages.
en.exaggerated: I automated the entire deployment process for the team.
en.no_data: After the page was written, other people could follow it.

zh.Situation: 實習時部署步驟只存在 chat thread，每個人做法都少少唔同。
zh.Task: 有人叫我寫低，而我要同平時負責嘅同事逐步核對。
zh.Action: 我一邊做兩次部署一邊記錄，再重寫成有實際指令同預期輸出嘅步驟。
zh.Result: 有兩位同事跟新頁面做都唔需要問人，一個可有可無嘅步驟亦被刪走。
zh.vague: 部署步驟只喺 chat 裡面。
zh.exaggerated: 我為團隊自動化咗成個部署流程。
zh.no_data: 頁面寫好之後，其他人跟得到。

en.Situation: We had never restored a database backup, and the first drill showed the restore took four hours instead of one.
en.Task: I owned the drill, and I had to report the real time rather than the time we had assumed.
en.Action: I timed each stage of the restore, found the slow step was index rebuild, and moved it to after the data check.
en.Result: The second drill finished in seventy minutes, and the report stated both the old and new times.
en.vague: The backup restore was slower than expected.
en.exaggerated: I made our disaster recovery bulletproof.
en.no_data: The second drill was faster and we wrote the times down.

zh.Situation: 我哋從來冇真正還原過資料庫備份，第一次演練顯示要四個鐘，而唔係以為嘅一個鐘。
zh.Task: 我負責演練，要報告真實時間而唔係假設嘅時間。
zh.Action: 我為每個還原階段計時，發現最慢係重建 index，於是把它移去數據核對之後。
zh.Result: 第二次演練七十分鐘完成，報告同時寫明新舊時間。
zh.exaggerated: 我令災難復原萬無一失。
zh.no_data: 第二次演練快咗，我哋記低咗時間。

en.Situation: Five years in, developers asked for production access weekly and each request took two days of approvals.
en.Task: I wanted them to debug faster without handing out standing production rights.
en.Action: I built a time-boxed access flow with a reason field and automatic expiry after four hours, then ran it with two volunteers.
en.Result: Median approval time dropped to thirty minutes, and every session was logged with its reason.
en.vague: Production access requests were slow and people complained.
en.exaggerated: I removed all risk from production access.
en.no_data: After the change access was granted faster.

zh.Situation: 做咗五年，開發同事每星期都要 production 權限，每次批核要兩日。
zh.Task: 我想佢哋除錯快啲，但唔可以派長期 production 權限。
zh.Action: 我做咗一個有時限嘅申請流程，要填原因、四小時後自動失效，再同兩位自願同事試行。
zh.Result: 批核中位數縮到三十分鐘，每次 session 都連原因記錄。
zh.vague: production 權限申請好慢，同事有投訴。
zh.exaggerated: 我消除咗 production 權限所有風險。
zh.no_data: 改完之後權限批得快咗。

en.Situation: In my first month, we deployed a service that worked in staging and crashed on start in production because of a missing environment variable.
en.Task: I was asked to make that class of failure impossible to miss before deploy.
en.Action: I added a startup check that lists every required variable and exits with all missing names, plus a test that runs the check with none set.
en.Result: The next missing variable was reported by name in the pipeline log, and the deploy stopped on its own.
en.vague: A deploy failed because of a missing setting.
en.exaggerated: I made all our services immune to configuration errors.
en.no_data: After the change the next missing setting was caught automatically.

zh.Situation: 第一個月，我們部署一個服務，喺 staging 正常但 production 一開就 crash，因為少咗一個環境變數。
zh.Task: 我要令呢類失敗喺部署前一定睇得見。
zh.Action: 我加啟動檢查，列出所有必需變數並在缺少時連名退出，再寫一個完全冇設定值嘅測試。
zh.Result: 下一次缺變數喺 pipeline log 有名有姓，部署自己停咗。
zh.vague: 有次部署因為少咗設定而失敗。
zh.exaggerated: 我令所有服務對設定錯誤免疫。
zh.no_data: 改完之後下次缺設定自動被捉。

en.Situation: At a property group, the nightly database backup ran at the same time as a reporting job and both slowed to a crawl.
en.Task: I had to separate them, and agree the new window with the reporting owner.
en.Action: I moved the backup two hours later, documented the new window, and watched both jobs for a week.
en.Result: Backup time fell from ninety minutes to twenty-five, and the morning report arrived before the office opened.
en.vague: Two jobs ran at the same time and both were slow.
en.exaggerated: I optimised the whole database estate for the company.
en.no_data: After the change both jobs were faster.

zh.Situation: 喺地產集團，每晚備份同一個報表 job 同時跑，兩邊都慢到離譜。
zh.Task: 我要分開佢哋，並同報表負責人議定新時間窗。
zh.Action: 我把備份推遲兩小時，寫低新窗口，再觀察兩個 job 一個星期。
zh.Result: 備份由九十分鐘減到廿五分鐘，早上報表喺開門前已到。
zh.vague: 兩個 job 同時跑，兩邊都慢。
zh.exaggerated: 我為公司優化咗整個資料庫群。
zh.no_data: 改完之後兩個 job 都快咗。

en.Situation: Six years in, a load test before a sale showed our service fell over at twice normal traffic.
en.Task: I had to give an honest capacity number to the business, not a comfortable one.
en.Action: I ran the test three times with different instance counts, plotted the failure point, and reported a safe limit with a margin.
en.Result: The business scaled the campaign to fit the limit, and the service held through the sale without throttling anyone.
en.vague: The load test showed some performance problems.
en.exaggerated: I made the service handle unlimited traffic.
en.no_data: After the test, the sale ran without problems.

zh.Situation: 做咗六年，大特賣前嘅壓力測試顯示服務喺兩倍正常流量就倒下。
zh.Task: 我要畀業務一個誠實嘅容量數字，而唔係好聽嘅數字。
zh.Action: 我用唔同 instance 數目跑三次，畫出失效點，再報告一個有餘裕嘅安全上限。
zh.Result: 業務按上限調整 campaign 規模，特賣期間服務撐住，亦冇 throttle 任何人。
zh.vague: 壓力測試顯示有啲效能問題。
zh.exaggerated: 我令服務可以承受無限流量。
zh.no_data: 測完之後特賣冇出問題。

en.Situation: On a six-month contract, I joined a team whose staging environment had drifted so far from production that testing meant little.
en.Task: I was asked to help, and I had to be honest that a full fix was bigger than my contract.
en.Action: I wrote down every difference I found in config and package versions, then rebuilt staging from the same image as production.
en.Result: Twelve differences were removed, and the next two releases passed staging and production with the same result.
en.vague: Staging and production were not the same.
en.exaggerated: I rebuilt the whole environment strategy for the company.
en.no_data: After the rebuild, staging results matched production.

zh.Situation: 做半年合約，我加入一個團隊，佢哋 staging 同 production 差異大到測試冇乜意義。
zh.Task: 有人叫我幫手，而我要老實講完整修好超出我合約範圍。
zh.Action: 我寫低所有 config 同套件版本差異，再用同 production 一樣嘅 image 重建 staging。
zh.Result: 十二個差異被消除，之後兩個版本喺 staging 同 production 結果一致。
zh.vague: staging 同 production 唔一樣。
zh.exaggerated: 我為公司重建咗成個環境策略。
zh.no_data: 重建之後 staging 結果同 production 對得上。

en.Situation: At a logistics company, a nightly container restart caused a five-minute gap in tracking updates and drivers called the hotline.
en.Task: I owned the schedule, and I had to remove the gap without a maintenance window the business would reject.
en.Action: I switched to a rolling restart with a readiness check, and ran it during office hours on purpose to prove the gap was gone.
en.Result: Tracking updates stopped having gaps, and the hotline calls about missing updates ended.
en.vague: There were short gaps in tracking data every night.
en.exaggerated: I eliminated all downtime for the tracking platform.
en.no_data: After the change the gaps stopped.

zh.Situation: 喺物流公司，每晚 container 重啟令追蹤更新有五分鐘空檔，司機打爆熱線。
zh.Task: 我負責個排程，要消除空檔，但唔可以用業務一定反對嘅維護窗口。
zh.Action: 我改成有 readiness check 嘅 rolling restart，並故意喺辦公時間跑一次證明空檔消失。
zh.Result: 追蹤更新唔再有空檔，關於冇更新的熱線電話亦停咗。
zh.vague: 每晚追蹤數據都有短暫空檔。
zh.exaggerated: 我消除咗追蹤平台所有停機。
zh.no_data: 改完之後空檔冇再出現。
